['ThyssenKrupp Rasselstein GmbH '].company_description: thyssenkrupp Rasselstein is a leading manufacturer of carbon flat steel and is known for its high-quality, precision-manufactured packaging steel. The company is a subsidiary of thyssenkrupp Steel Europe and operates as one of the three largest packaging steel producers in Europe. Its production facility in Andernach, Germany, is the world's largest of its kind, producing around 1.5 million tons of packaging steel annually for customers in 80 countries.
